Given_When_Then: Given Entity A requests FX forward and Person T works for reported parent B; When working scope is recorded; Then Entity A remains the counterparty and coordination does not grant signing or trading authority.
Given applicability is unknown; When the requirement set is presented; Then unknown remains explicit and cannot satisfy readiness or become not_required.

Given an artifact is received and its purpose assessment is insufficient; When the case is reevaluated; Then the linked requirement stays unsatisfied and file presence alone cannot make the case ready.
Given two request items have separate contributor grants; When one contributor submits one item; Then only its receipt changes and the other item and overall clearance stay unresolved.
Given population scope is empty, stale or unconfirmed; When screening or readiness is evaluated; Then coverage is not complete and the case cannot become ready.
Given a Credit input changes after Legal consumed it; When Legal is reviewed; Then its consumed version is visibly stale and execution/readiness remains blocked until reviewed.

Given readiness is ready for authorised confirmation and no decision is recorded; When QA, RM or an unknown role attempts confirmation; Then the action is rejected and no clearance decision is created.

Given a branch hold with explicit current dependencies; When impact is projected; Then affected work is identified, unrelated work requires an explicit permitted basis, and unknown dependencies remain unknown.

Given all applicable prerequisites are satisfied without an authorised decision; When readiness is evaluated; Then it is READY_FOR_AUTHORISED_CONFIRMATION, not CLEARED_TO_TRADE; after an authorised decision a publication failure retains that decision and executes no trade.

Given saved work at a scene and viewport; When Product returns after language change or Story/graph/Lab/print is used; Then the latest language and saved revision remain and no view control records a business decision.
